column1: # source: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) — Umm al-Qura calendar site
column2: daily prayer timetable of 13 Saudi cities on the front page of ummulqura.org.sa

column1: # notes: KACST computes the prayer times the Kingdom publishes and the Umm al-Qura calendar itself
column2: so these tables are the MAKKAH method's own authority. The site is unreachable from the development network and its current pages build the table in the browser
column3: so every day here was read from an Internet Archive capture of the older server-rendered page; the capture column names it and page_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the bytes it was read from (capture URL: https://web.archive.org/web/<capture>id_/http://www.ummulqura.org.sa/). The pages are cited rather than copied. Facts extracted into docs/sources/saudi/umm-al-qura-prayer-tables.json (sha256 in docs/sources/saudi/SHA256SUMS)
column4: from which tools/saudi/umm_al_qura_prayer_golden.py generates this file; nothing is typed by hand. Times are local standard time (UTC+3
column5: no daylight saving) converted from the page's unmarked 12-hour clock
column6: and are rounded to the minute by the authority. Only Makkah is compared against the app: KACST publishes no coordinates
column7: and Makkah's are the ones the method is defined at (21.4225 N
